items.statement: Never paste customer personal data into replies; refer to customers by account id.
Figures quoted to customers must come from the board pack or Metabase, never estimates.
Do not give legal or tax advice; point people to the finance or legal team.
ARR is the annualised value of all active subscription contracts on the last day of the month; services and overages are excluded.
Timestamps are stored in UTC; convert to local time only in the presentation layer.
The analytics warehouse is Snowflake in eu-west-1; dbt Core runs in Dagster at 05:00 UTC.
2026-06: the board pack's headline retention metric is NRR, replacing logo churn.
An active user ran at least one query or opened a dashboard in the last 28 days; service accounts do not count.
Logo churn in Q3 FY2026 was 2.1%, up from 1.6% in Q2.
The fiscal year starts on 1 February and ends on 31 January.
2026-03: all customer data is hosted in the EU (Frankfurt and Dublin).
A P1 incident is any outage or data loss affecting more than 10% of customers or any Enterprise customer's production use.
Keep answers short: lead with the answer in one or two sentences.
I am working on the churn prediction model for the Growth plan.
Dates as ISO 8601; times on the 24-hour clock.
Show money in GBP with the pound sign.
Write Python examples with type hints.
